quote: This work explores the potential for using SLMs in content moderation, evaluating their performance relative to LLMs in terms of accuracy, recall, and precision across multiple online communities on Reddit.
datasets: Reddit comment removals between May 10th, 2016 and February 4th, 2017
outputs: moderation decision (True/False) for whether a comment is undesirable based on subreddit rules and context

quote: For our evaluation tasks in the balanced setting, we focus on the metrics of accuracy, precision, and recall. ... for the imbalanced setting, we focus on the AUC score

We find that the fine-tuned SLMs outperform the LLMs by an average 11.5% in accuracy across 15 subreddits... SLMs demonstrate the highest recall in all 15 subreddits... LLMs achieve the highest precision in 14 out of 15 subreddits...
